svg.title: HSM Core Service Architecture
svg.desc: Centralized encryption service using Azure Key Vault HSM with DEK/KEK envelope encryption pattern, plus the Tier 3 Bulk PoC (POST /dek/issue and /dek/unwrap on CORE SERVICE itself, paired with the separate hsm-bulk-client), dek_name reuse, and BULK File's ciphertext-format interoperability with CORE SERVICE's own /decrypt, guarded by CoreBulkFileInteropTest
svg.text: Bearer JWT + end_user_id · client calls after PBAC ALLOW
Service SPN: read · Rotation SPN: write
Separate K8S service · HSM Service SPN
Generate: DEK = random_bytes(32) (or reuse via dek_name)
EDEK = KEK.wrap(DEK) → stored in EDEK Store
Response: { ciphertext } ← only field client needs to store
grant check → Redis HIT (skip KV) / MISS → KV unwrap → AES-GCM
Response: { plaintext } ← only field client needs
Rotation SVC: gen bytes → write inactive slot → update current_key
Pods poll 30s: detect slot or kv_version change → rotate(cek, slot, ver)
Redis key: {slot}:{kv_ver}:{edek_id} · prev slot readable via fallback
Old {slot}:{old_ver}:* entries expire via 60s TTL — no flush needed
Same per-item crypto path, looped — no new EDEK-writing path
N items/call, keyed by caller's own id · cap = batch-max-items (100)
Always 200 · per-item status success/error (bad batch itself → 422)
Not part of the encryption solution
same edek_records table · same process as /decrypt
standalone batch job · BULK DB / BULK File
plaintext never leaves CLNT's host; real KEK never seen
dek-name on a column: ONE /dek/issue for
the whole job run, not once per row
Workload Identity (jobs longer than a token's TTL)
CORE SERVICE's real /decrypt reads it as-is
BULK File job: each chunk's plaintext base64-encoded before AES-256-GCM — survives CORE SERVICE's own /decrypt UTF-8 response encoding losslessly
FileBulkJob.reconstructCoreServiceToken(edek_id, iv, tag, ciphertext) — same token format CORE SERVICE itself produces, now true for files too
Optional compress-before-encrypt: gzip + 1-byte marker inside the AEAD payload, before base64 — decrypt always reads it, no config to coordinate
CoreBulkFileInteropTest (hsm-bulk-client) — real CORE SERVICE process, both endpoint shapes + compression, every build
